title: DeterminantSplitLinearBijective
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C$ a short complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $n=r+s$ and assume $A$ is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Let $U$ be open and $e:B|_U\simeq A|_U\oplus C|_U$ satisfy $ef|_U=\mathrm{inl}$ and $\mathrm{pr}_2e=g|_U$. For each $W\subseteq U$ let $l_W:C(W)\to B(W)$ be any function with $g_W l_W=\mathrm{id}$. Exterior powers mean [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Assume also $C$ finite locally free of rank $s$. Suppose given $\mathcal O_X(W)$-linear maps $d_W:(\bigwedge^r A\otimes\bigwedge^s C)(W)\to(\bigwedge^n B)(W)$ for all $W\subseteq U$, satisfying $d_W((\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge b_j))=\bigwedge(f(a_i),l_W(b_j))$ for all tuples, with included entries preceding lifted entries and reindexing by $n=r+s$. Then each $x\in U$ has an open neighborhood $V\subseteq U$ such that $d_W$ is bijective for every open $W\subseteq V$. The maps are given, and are not assumed to commute with restriction.

proof.text: Apply the common free-chart comparison to obtain outside section bases, the section splitting eW, and bijectivity of the middle exterior unit and outside tensor comparison. Transport the given d along these actual comparisons. Its formula transports to the algebraic wedge formula.

Extend the given lifts of the quotient basis vectors linearly using Basis.constr. Its composite with g is the identity, checked on this basis. The map f.coprod t from A(W) times C(W) to B(W) is bijective: under eW it is the triangular map (a,c) to (a+pr1(eW(t(c))),c), whose inverse subtracts the same first coordinate. Thus the product of the two outside bases, mapped along this equivalence, is a basis of B(W). The given d sends the tensor of the two top basis wedges to the top wedge of this middle basis, by its assumed formula evaluated only on the basis tuples. The top exterior bases and their tensor product are singleton bases, including empty blocks and zero rings. Basis.ext identifies the transported d with their basis linear equivalence; hence d is bijective after composing the comparisons. No lift-independence or direct-sum exterior lemma is used.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_split_linear_maps_locally_bijective {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] [S.X₃.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₃]
    (U : X.Opens)
    (e : S.X₂.restrict U.ι ≅ S.X₁.restrict U.ι ⊞ S.X₃.restrict U.ι)
    (hf : (restrictFunctor U.ι).map S.f ≫ e.hom = biprod.inl)
    (hg : e.hom ≫ biprod.snd = (restrictFunctor U.ι).map S.g)
    (l : ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U → S.X₃.val.obj (op W) → S.X₂.val.obj (op W))
    (hl : ∀ W hW b, S.g.val.app (op W) (l W hW b) = b)
    (d : ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U →
      (exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.obj (op W)
        →ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.obj (op W))
    (hd : ∀ W hW (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op W))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op W)),
        d W hW (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ W a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ W b)) =
        exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ W
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op W) (a j))
            (fun j ↦ l W hW (b j)) (Fin.cast hr i))) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧
      ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ V), Function.Bijective (d W (hW.trans hVU))
